none: PAS NLM-7C9270: Roman coin: Possible Radiate of Claudius II from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, possibly of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP[--]. Reverse description: Providentia standing left holding globe in right hand and cornucopiae in left. Reverse inscription: PROVIDENTIA AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: 12
